title: Quadratic linear proof index
statement: For a Boolean circuit $C$ with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates, let $q=1+n+g$ and let the proof length be $q+2^q+2^{q^2}$. The quadratic linear proof index assigns each index in $	ext{Fin}(2^q)$ an index in $	ext{Fin}(q+2^q+2^{q^2})$ by first applying the quadratic linear proof-index map and then the circuit's inner proof-index map.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit C with n input bits
An index in Fin(2^q), where q=1+n+gateCount(C)
